svg.title: Equipotentials of a negatively charged conductor
svg.desc: Computed equipotentials around a negatively charged, rounded oblong conductor. The conductor itself is one equipotential. The nearest equipotentials follow its oblong shape and are most crowded off the rounded ends, where the negative surface charge, shown by minus signs, is most dense and the field is strongest. Farther out they become rounder, and far away they are circles centred on the object, like those of a point charge. Faint field lines point inward, meeting the conductor at right angles. The potential increases outward, away from the conductor.
